hints.content:
If we take the derivative with respect to $~x~$ of both sides of the given information, we obtain the result.

$\displaystyle{{D}_{x}}\left( \frac{10}{1-10x} \right)={{D}_{x}}\left( 10+100x+1000{{x}^{2}}+...+{{\left( 10 \right)}^{n+1}}{{x}^{n}} \right)$

question.content:
We know that

 $\displaystyle\frac{10}{1-10x}=10+100x+1000{{x}^{2}}+...+{{\left( 10 \right)}^{n+1}}{{x}^{n}}+...$

for $x\in \left(-\dfrac{1}{10},\dfrac{1}{10}\right)$.

**Using this fact, find the power series for $\dfrac{100}{(1-10x)^2}$.**
